stake.name: the held fraction moves by half of what doubling the rent can move it
stake.arithmetic: stake = 0.5 * |f(E) - f(2E)| / f(E), f(E) = 1/(1+e^-E), computed from the chart's own rent before any step: FLUID-1's plants were typed at 0.20 against a reach of 0.085 and both were unreachable by the freeze's own arithmetic
